item.title: CVE-2026-19868 — SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN
item.description: Threat Signal 62. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).
